problem.passage:
An urban planning department in a mid-sized city analyzed average commute times by mode of transportation across four consecutive years as part of a study on the effects of a new bus rapid transit (BRT) line that opened in Year 2.

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the statement: "The largest decrease in average commute time for bus riders between two consecutive years occurred ______"?
problem.stimulus: An urban planning department in a mid-sized city analyzed average commute times by mode of transportation across four consecutive years as part of a study on the effects of a new bus rapid transit (BRT) line that opened in Year 2.
problem.question: Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the statement: "The largest decrease in average commute time for bus riders between two consecutive years occurred ______"?
options: between Year 1 and Year 2, when bus commute time fell from 42 to 41 minutes
between Year 2 and Year 3, when bus commute time fell from 41 to 33 minutes
between Year 3 and Year 4, when bus commute time fell from 33 to 31 minutes
between Year 2 and Year 3, when bicycle commute time fell from 34 to 33 minutes
problem.explanation: Bus 계열의 연도별 값을 비교하면 Year 2(41분)에서 Year 3(33분)로 8분 감소한 것이 가장 큰 하락폭이다. 다른 구간은 1~2분 감소에 그친다. 따라서 정답은 B번이다.
problem.explanationEn: Comparing consecutive-year values in the Bus series, the drop from Year 2 (41 minutes) to Year 3 (33 minutes) is 8 minutes, the largest decrease. Other intervals show decreases of only 1-2 minutes. Therefore, the correct answer is B.

distractorRationales.matches: Year 1 to Year 2 is a real consecutive-year pair for Bus
distractorRationales.plausible_because: It correctly identifies the Bus series and correct year labels
distractorRationales.why_wrong: The decrease is only 1 minute (42 to 41), far smaller than the Year 2-to-Year 3 drop

distractorRationales.matches: Year 3 to Year 4 is a real consecutive-year pair for Bus
distractorRationales.plausible_because: It correctly identifies a decrease in the Bus series
distractorRationales.why_wrong: The decrease is only 2 minutes (33 to 31), smaller than the 8-minute drop between Year 2 and Year 3

distractorRationales.matches: Bicycle data also decreases between Year 2 and Year 3
distractorRationales.plausible_because: It uses the correct year range but the wrong transportation mode
distractorRationales.why_wrong: The question asks specifically about bus riders, and the bicycle decrease is only 1 minute, not the largest change

problem.evidenceSpan: Series: Bus, categories: Year 2 (41) to Year 3 (33)
problem.answerRationale: The decrease from 41 to 33 minutes for the Bus series between Year 2 and Year 3 is 8 minutes, the largest single-year drop among all consecutive-year comparisons in the Bus series.

difficultyReasons: 표에서 버스 항목만 비교하면 되는 1단계 추론
네 구간의 차이를 계산해 최대값을 찾는 단순 비교
D는 질문의 대상(버스)과 다른 교통수단을 사용해 쉽게 배제 가능
전체적으로 표 값만 정확히 읽으면 풀리는 medium 수준 문제

distractors.plausibleBecause: Year 1에서 Year 2 구간은 실제로 감소를 보여주므로 방향은 맞다
distractors.whyWrong: 감소폭이 단 1분으로 가장 작은 변화이며 최대 감소가 아니다

distractors.plausibleBecause: Year3에서 Year4도 감소이며 최근 구간이라 그럴듯해 보일 수 있다
Year2-Year3 구간이라는 정답과 같은 시간대를 가리키지만 다른 교통수단 데이터를 사용한다
distractors.matches: Bicycle Year2=34, Year3=33 데이터와 일치하며 질문의 시간대와 일치
distractors.whyWrong: 질문은 버스 승객의 통근시간 감소를 묻는데 자전거 데이터를 사용했으므로 질문에 답하지 않음
